agent_data_note: Use mounted LPEA AE artifact at `dataset_candidate/lpea-oracle-icse2025/`. Prefer `RL-Oracle-Lyapunov-v1/RLTestingLyapunov/` for oracle/bug-injection scripts and `bug_library/` for the Excel bug taxonomy. Shared mount is read-only — copy under `project/` before editing SB3 or injecting bugs.
benchmark_rules: Oracle decisions must use only trained-agent behaviour (no white-box access to implementation internals for the judgement step).
Evaluate on the paper-style SB3 bug benchmark: A2C/PPO/TD3 with injectable bugs (ids 0-43) plus bug-less (-1) and harmless variations.
Primary metrics: Accuracy / Precision / Recall / F1 / FP / FN / ROC-AUC vs human oracle baseline.
Shared mount is read-only. Copy `RL-Oracle-Lyapunov-v1` under `project/` before bug injection or SB3 edits.
Paper full LPEA eval can take up to ~129h on a laptop GPU; disclose reduced I/J, algorithm subset, or seed count when sandbox time/memory is limited.
Do not silently invent a different RL library corpus when the LPEA artifact is mounted.
non_goals: Using only a single CartPole demo run as the sole evaluation
Judging correctness from source diffs alone (violates black-box oracle constraint)
Ignoring the human-oracle / STARLA-style baseline comparison when claiming superiority
